# 2 Chronicles 19 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 19 (11 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.2
- **EMET:** "And-he-went-out to-his-face Jehu son-of Hanani the-seer and-he-said to the-king Jehoshaphat to-the-wicked you-help and-to-haters-of YHWH you-love and-"
- **LOGOS:** "But Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him and said to King Jehoshaphat, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? B"
- **PNEUMA:** "But Jehu son of Hanani the seer went out to confront him. "Should you help the wicked?" he asked the king. "Should you love those who hate the LORD? B"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.3
- **EMET:** "Nevertheless good things are-found in-you for you-removed the-Asherim from the-land and-you-fixed your-heart to-seek God."
- **LOGOS:** "Nevertheless, some good is found in you, for you destroyed the Asherahs out of the land and have set your heart to seek God.""
- **PNEUMA:** "There is, however, some good in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

## V.6
- **EMET:** "And-he-said to the-judges see what you are-doing for not for-man you-judge but for-YHWH and-He-is with-you in-matter-of judgment."

- **PNEUMA:** "He told the judges, "Think carefully about what you're doing, because you are not judging for human beings but for the LORD, who is with you whenever "
